findings.label: Hidden URL filters on the employee list
findings.detail: parseListParams/TaskListSection still forward q and assignedToId on /employee although the search box and employee filter are hidden, so /employee?q=… silently narrows the list and the empty state says 'Try a different search'. The API scope prevents any data leak.
findings.action: Strip q/assignedToId in TaskListSection when showSearch/showEmployeeFilter are false, or adjust the empty-state copy to the visible controls.

findings.label: Comment 404 path untested
findings.detail: Add-comment errors other than validation (404 after delete/reassign) go through reportTaskError (toast + refetch → Task not found) but have no e2e coverage; the coder lists this as a known gap.
findings.action: Add an e2e case in chunk D (delete or reassign the task, then post a comment).
